verdict.rationale: Salesforce's Sales Engagement feature ('engagement built directly into your CRM', docs-19) and automatic email sync (docs-8) point to templated/sequenced outreach capability, and a community comment corroborates quickly setting up timed/templated emails in SFDC (salesforce-comm-2). However, the evidence pack lacks first-party documentation specifically naming 'email templates' or 'multi-step sequences/cadences' features, or hands-on proof of sequence automation. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on Sales Engagement/Cadences feature set, screenshots or independent reviews of multi-step sequence building, and confirmation of template management UI.
